findingDetails: BrowserAutomation copied raw guest console values/descriptions into retained history. Secrets printed by a page could be returned through the authenticated bridge.
Network failure events were retained wholesale and disposed automation objects kept their diagnostic arrays.
implementation: Retain only console event kind, timestamp and argument types; never raw argument values, descriptions, previews or stacks.
Network failures retain only resource type, timestamp, cancellation and symbolic Chromium error code. Discard arbitrary fields, URLs, request ids, headers and bodies.
Dispose clears diagnostic arrays and request tracking together with native listeners and the debugger lease.

100-row bound, closing background page without reveal and disabling bridge/guests.
